# Flyology HTTP

> Experimental HTTP/1.1 client and application-server library for native and lightweight Flyology tasks.

Flyology HTTP exposes synchronous Ada APIs in both task lanes. It provides an origin-bound client with bounded connection pools and streaming request/response bodies, plus a server foundation with optional routing, middleware, SSE, WebSockets, native offload, and provider-neutral TLS. It does not currently provide HTTP/2, proxying, or content decoding, and it makes no production-qualification claim.

## Package names

- Root: Flyology.HTTP

- Server protocol: Flyology.HTTP.Server
- Server applications: Flyology.HTTP.Server.Applications
